research_question: Can one minimal supervised model route a fixed 90-minute accumulation-manipulation-distribution cycle strongly enough to materially close the realistic after-cost 1% daily NAV-growth gap?
smc_ict_explanation: Each America/New_York-midnight-anchored 90-minute cycle is divided into three completed 30-minute thirds. The first freezes the accumulation box. The second must raid and reclaim exactly one box boundary. At the third-third open, a pooled model estimates whether price will deliver to the untouched accumulation boundary before invalidating beyond the actual manipulation extreme.

distinct_scope.non_overlap: The reported latent HMM PO3 model learned generic bar states and failed its frozen gate. This claim uses exogenous 90-minute boundaries, a supervised structural target-before-stop label and one regularized logistic model. It does not retune the HMM, fixed Silver Bullet windows, FVG/OTE acceptance, option flow, L2 hazard OCO, cross-venue or cross-asset models.

market_contract.source: official Bybit public native five-minute monthly archives
market_contract.final_practical_execution_requirement: Any survivor must retain the unchanged model and route under exact Bybit BBO/depth, actual funding and latency-aware fills before ranking or practical use.

information_contract.cycle_anchor: America/New_York local midnight with historical DST
information_contract.complete_cycle_requirement: Exactly eighteen contiguous valid five-minute bars with positions 0 through 17. Spring-forward and fall-back malformed cycles are rejected rather than reconstructed.
information_contract.decision_availability: All six manipulation bars are completed; decision timestamp equals the next five-minute open.
information_contract.calibration: calendar 2022; select at most one threshold
information_contract.development: calendar 2023 opens only after the full 2022 gate
information_contract.walkforward_rule: Before each half-year, refit the same model on resolved prior events only. The feature set, route, thresholds, sizing, costs and gates remain frozen.
information_contract.future_label_rule: Unresolved events at a fit cutoff are censored and excluded. Same-bar target/stop is a stop. Source gaps after entry receive the structural stop.

event_contract.accumulation: first six completed bars freeze high, low, range and volume
event_contract.manipulation: next six completed bars must exceed exactly one boundary by max(1bp of price, 5% of box range) and finish back inside the box
event_contract.side: low sweep implies long; high sweep implies short
event_contract.stop: beyond the actual manipulation extreme by the same structural buffer
event_contract.both_side_sweep: excluded because intracycle order is not identifiable from five-minute bars
event_contract.gap_stop: adverse open when worse than the stop
event_contract.source_boundary: marked at the final valid market price for NAV and separately disqualifies the gate as unresolved

model_contract.label: untouched accumulation boundary reached before structural raid stop
model_contract.tie_and_slot_score: 24bp cost-adjusted expected value, then probability, then stable symbol order
prohibited: risk or leverage rescue of negative expectancy

account_contract.participation_cap: 0.1% of prior completed five-minute quote volume
account_contract.funding_proxy: adverse 2bp for each crossed UTC eight-hour boundary in the initial OHLC screen
account_contract.quantity_rule: minimum of NAV-risk, 10x NAV notional and participation limits
account_contract.top_trade_removal: identify top positive events on the 18bp path, exclude their event keys before global slot competition and replay from initial NAV
